user.title: Automation Advisor setup
user.description: v1 matches devices to a builtin catalog. v2 also learns from your manual actions locally (not other homes). Optional LLM only explains verified habits — it never writes YAML. For Spark vLLM use Base URL like http://<spark>:8000/v1.

data.trial_mode: Register in trial mode (recommended — automations start disabled)
data.habit_learning: Learn habits from my manual actions (local SQLite)
data.min_observe_days: Minimum observation days before habit suggestions
data.community_stub: Show stub similar-home acceptance rates on catalog tips
data.llm_base_url: LLM Base URL (e.g. http://172.30.1.x:8000/v1). Empty disables LLM
data.llm_api_key: Optional API key (usually empty for vLLM; required for OpenAI cloud)
